name: dn-multi-ava-vs-single-ava-rdn-invalid
description: permittedSubtrees directoryName has a multi-AVA RDN (O=Example+OU=Engineering). The leaf's matching RDN position is a single-AVA RDN containing only O=Example. RFC 5280 7.1 requires the two RDNs to have the same number of naming attributes to match; since they don't, the leaf is outside the permitted subtree and must be rejected.
notes: Implementations that lazily compare only the attributes they recognise (e.g. picking the first AVA from the constraint and checking it against the leaf's RDN) may incorrectly accept this.
